item.title: 'Sakamoto Days 2nd Season' Unveils Additional Cast, Opening Theme, First Promo
item.description: The official website of the Sakamoto Days television anime unveiled a pair of additional cast, key visual (pictured), the opening theme, and first promotional video for the second season on Wednesday. The anime adapting Yuuto Suzuki's action comedy manga is scheduled to premiere on TV Tokyo and its affiliated networks on January 19, 2027, at 12:00 a.m. It will also air on BS TV Tokyo on January 25 at 12:40 a.m. The first episode will be available for advance streaming on Netflix.
